create_stereo_dataset: create a StereoDataset subclass to load left-right image pairs and disparity maps for stereo depth estimation training
build_sceneflow_dataset: build a SceneFlowDataset to load driving, monkaa, and flyingthings stereo pairs with finalpass or cleanpass splits
run_train_dataset_stereo: run get_train_dataset_stereo with a dataset string like SceneFlowDataset(train_allpass) to get an augmented training dataset
test_stereo_datasets: test get_test_datasets_stereo with a plus-separated string like Kitti15Dataset(test)+MiddleburyEval3Dataset(test_full) to get evaluation datasets
visualize_disparity_map: visualize a disparity numpy array with vis_disparity using min/max normalization and an inferno colormap
